senseWindows.label: SUCCESSION d9: Sung → Priya (trust 58, not-veteran)
lines: [d7] Back at the haven the argument starts: Priya is calling it "The Big Beast." They'll fight it out — weigh in if you want.
[d7] You walk back into Haven. 9 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
[d7] "So we made it OFFICIAL! The PARTY SYSTEM! Up to THREE companions! Formal! Tracked! With a UI! The audience can see your party composition now! Very important for the betting markets!"
[d7] A new option appears when you look at people: invite them to your party.
[d7] 💡 Learned: PARTY SYSTEM. You can invite people to travel and fight beside you. Ask — in conversation, like a person.
[d7] SYSTEM: Catalogued. The Codex grows teeth.
[d7] 📚 Village knowledge: Ella taught everyone about Mango. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
[d7] 📚 Village knowledge: Wassim taught everyone about Lamb's Quarters. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
[d7] 📚 Village knowledge: Henry taught everyone about White Crossberry. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
[d7] Elif brought you a sample. The Codex grows.
[d7] 🍽️ Wassim looks at the full shelves and waves off the day's share. "No more into the store — we eat at the fire, and the shelves keep."
[d8] 📓 Codex: Priya — jotted down what they said. Filed.
[d8] You walk back into Haven. 13 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
[d8] Naran looks at the pantry, then at the Codex, then at you. "We’re going to make it." Haven will survive — because someone learned the land, and wrote it down. One less thing to fear.
[d8] 📋 SYSTEM QUEST: "Teach us? Show us a plant you know COMPLETELY (Codex L3) — 13 candidates in your notes. We will watch very closely. Reward: integration."
[d8] 📓 Codex: Drum-Belly, Murkcap, Murkcap, Sweeps Week, Drum-Belly at the door, day 8.
[d8] 📖 The Codex settles deeper into you. It knows things before you do now. Deaths, especially — it will tell you itself.
[d8] 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Murkcap is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
[d8] 🍽️ Raj looks at the full shelves and waves off the day's share. "No more into the store — we eat at the fire, and the shelves keep."
[d8] 📓 Codex: Tejaswini taught Naran Mediation.
[d9] 📖 Codex: Belly-Drum Thunderclap — hits everything close around it. You won't forget this.
[d9] You STRIKE the tanuki for 15.

[d9] 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Drum-Belly: Strike the taut drum. When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer.

[d9] 📓 Codex: Counter: Strike the taut drum — When the belly swells drum-taut, STRIKE — the stretched skin is thin as a drumhead and the thunderclap backfires, stunning it senseless. Hit the drum, not the drummer.
[d9] 📖 Codex: Trickster's Feint — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
[d9] You STRIKE the tanuki for 10.
[d9] You STRIKE the tanuki for 13.
[d9] You STRIKE the tanuki for 14.
[d9] Your scars ITCH — and hold. You should be down, but the scars remember every almost-death and refuse a new one. (Scar Tissue: held at 25% HP.)
[d9] 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Sung Sanchez is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
[d9] 🕯️ Sung Sanchez is dead — combat. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
[d9] The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Priya blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
[d9] 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
[d9] 📖 The Codex turns a page: Sung Sanchez, 9 days. The mantle passes to Priya Shevchenko.
[d9] ⚔️ Tejaswini stood down the Drum-Belly and kept walking — 3 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
[d9] ⚔️ Ella stood down the Murkcap and kept walking — 4 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
[d9] ⚔️ Naran killed the Murkcap alone — 3 rounds, 10 taken. Word travels fast. The village cheers.
[d9] You walk back into Haven. 17 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.

[d9] 📓 Codex: Counter: Stay out of the sporefall — The spores only drift so far and sink in still air. When the gills start breathing, back off and let the cloud settle — then move in while it recovers. Never stand downwind of a breathing cap.

[d9] 🌙 Night. The lingering Sweeps Week gorges at the treeline — 1,700 kcal gone from the stores. Endure it (they drift off within ~6 nights — the gorge is the price), or send a sortie: fighters, rations, real risk.
[d9] 📓 Codex: a frightened family arrived (fleeing).
[d9] 📚 Village knowledge: Vasyl taught everyone about Yarrow. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
[d9] 📓 Codex: Naran taught Tejaswini Gossip Network.

[d10] 📓 Codex: you've heard of **Echo Location**. Someone, somewhere, can do this. Now you know its name.
[d10] 📓 Codex: Wassim chose Echo Location (echo_location) at Field 1.
[d10] ⚔️ Vasyl stood down the Sweeps Week and kept walking — 3 rounds, bloodied but breathing. It's still out there, somewhere.
[d10] You walk back into Haven. 18 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.

[d11] You STRIKE the tiger for 12.
[d11] You STRIKE the tiger for 10.

[d11] You STRIKE the tiger for 9.
[d11] You STRIKE the tiger for 14.

Never turn, never run; running is prey. Hold its gaze and back away slow. (You lived to tell it — twice — and now you see the pattern.)

[d11] ◈ RESONANCE HARMONICS — SYSTEM: "HYPOTHESIS CONFIRMED. Objects with high observer-attention waveforms function as auxiliary capacitors. We call this RESONANCE HARMONICS. We do not know why the waveforms taste like grief. We have stopped asking." — Hold a keepsake. Think about them. The System will do the math. (It is not math. It is love. The System will never know.) Channel keepsakes from your pack.
